summary: Queries the current display mode from a DirectX device object. Calls the device vtable method at offset 0x20 on the device pointer stored at this+0x10FC (this[1087]) and stores the returned code in this+0x0. On failure (non-zero code) it logs the 'Could not get current display mode' error string via sub_53C590 and returns -1. On success it copies the two returned mode fields out to the optional a2 and a3 outputs, and, when a4 is provided, sets the display mode via sub_55C450 using the local format value v8 (with a special case that substitutes format 21 when v8 equals 22). Returns 0 on success.

local_names.this: DirectX video/device wrapper object whose this+0x10FC holds the device pointer
local_names.v5: return code of the vtable method call, stored at this+0x0
local_names.v7: output struct written by the vtable method; v7[0]/v7[1] copied to a2/a3
local_names.v8: local format value compared against 22; never assigned in the decompiled body
local_names.a2: optional output pointer for mode field 0 (v7[0])
local_names.a3: optional output pointer for mode field 1 (v7[1])
local_names.a4: optional pointer passed through to the set-display-mode call sub_55C450

operations.description: Invoke the DirectX device method at vtable offset 0x20 on the device object read from this+0x10FC (this[1087]), passing (device, 0, &v7); the stdcall result is stored in v5.
*this = v5: store the vtable method return code into this+0x0.
When v5 is non-zero (the call failed), take the error path that logs and returns -1.
Log the failure via sub_53C590(-1, aCouldNotGetCur), passing the 'Could not get current display mode' string global.
When a2 is non-null, write v7[0] (mode field 0 returned by the vtable method) to *a2.
When a3 is non-null, write v7[1] (mode field 1 returned by the vtable method) to *a3.
When a4 is non-null, enter the set-display-mode path.
When the local format value v8 equals 22, take the special-case format path instead of the general one.
Special case: sub_55C450(21, 0, a4) sets the display mode with format 21 when the read format v8 is 22.
Return 0 immediately after the special-case set-display-mode call.
General case: sub_55C450(v8, 0, a4) sets the display mode with the read format v8 for every other format.
Invoked from VidMan_Enter (0x004FA000) during video-manager enter/initialization.

unresolved: v8 is read in the set-display-mode path but never assigned in the decompiled body; it is likely a decompiler artifact of the display-mode format field returned through the v7 output struct, but its exact source is not established by the raw source.
The identity of the vtable+0x20 method as GetDisplayMode and the roles of v7[0]/v7[1] as width/height come from the existing analysis prose, not from the raw source alone.
The special-case interpretation of format 22 (and the swap to 21) as an A8R8G8B8 pixel-format rule is existing-analysis prose and is not independently proven.
The owner type of this and the device object at this+0x10FC remain unknown; caller VidMan_Enter (0x004FA000) does not identify the class.
